name: Role
rationale: Role is an enumerated entity type used to represent the RBAC roles mentioned in the gradebook slice.
plain_english_summary: A role is a label such as student, TA, faculty member, or faculty-family member assigned to a user.
source_excerpt:
students, teaching assistants,
faculty, and related faculty-family roles

name: User
rationale: User is the principal type whose role membership determines gradebook permissions and disjointness constraints.
plain_english_summary: A user is a person using the gradebook system.
source_excerpt:
No user should be able to both receive and assign external grades through any
combination of roles.

name: User__roles
rationale: The roles set records the combinations of roles that drive RBAC authorization decisions.
plain_english_summary: This lists all roles the user has, such as student, TA, faculty, or faculty family.
alternatives_considered: Model Student, TeachingAssistant, Faculty, and FacultyFamily as separate principal entity types, but role combinations need to be represented on the same user.

name: InternalGrade
rationale: InternalGrade is a protected grade resource with permissions distinct from external grades.
plain_english_summary: An internal grade is a grade record used inside the gradebook process.

name: ExternalGrade
rationale: ExternalGrade is a protected grade resource subject to receive, assign, view, and disjointness requirements.
plain_english_summary: An external grade is a grade record that can be received by some users and assigned or viewed by faculty.

name: Course
rationale: Course is the resource type needed for enrollment actions.
plain_english_summary: A course is something a non-faculty subject may enroll in.

name: assignInternalGrade
rationale: This action models assigning internal grades, which is explicitly permitted for faculty and teaching assistants.
plain_english_summary: A user assigns an internal grade.
source_excerpt: Teaching assistants can view and assign internal grades

name: assignExternalGrade
rationale: This action models assigning external grades, which is allowed for faculty and forbidden for students and teaching assistants.
plain_english_summary: A user assigns an external grade.
source_excerpt: Faculty members can assign internal grades and external grades.

name: viewInternalGrade
rationale: This action models viewing internal grades, which is explicitly available to faculty and teaching assistants.
plain_english_summary: A user views an internal grade.
source_excerpt: Teaching assistants can view and assign internal grades

name: viewExternalGrade
rationale: This action models viewing external grades, which is explicitly available to faculty and forbidden for teaching assistants.
plain_english_summary: A user views an external grade.
source_excerpt: Faculty members can view internal grades and external grades.

name: receiveExternalGrade
rationale: This action models receiving external grades, which is allowed for students and faculty-family members and disjoint from assigning external grades.
plain_english_summary: A user receives an external grade.

name: enrollInCourse
rationale: This action models course enrollment, which is permitted when the subject is not a faculty member.
plain_english_summary: A user enrolls in a course.
source_excerpt: If a subject is not a faculty member, that subject may enroll in courses.
